name: eu-ctr-results
title: Results reported as the EU Clinical Trials Regulation requires
description: Whether a trial's results documents report how many participants took part, give a result for every registered primary endpoint, and whether the trial enrolled nobody: the three questions Bruckner et al.'s reviewers answered for each results document (Regulation 536/2014). Not reported needs the whole document read; anything the rules can't settle is undecided, for a person.

requirements.question: How many participants actually took part (enrolled, randomised, treated or analysed)? Quote the actual number, not a planned or target number.
requirements.guidance: Use numeric_result when the passage gives the number.

requirements.question: Does the document say the trial enrolled nobody (cancelled before the first participant, or zero participants overall)? Quote that statement if there is one.
requirements.guidance: A trial that started and stopped early is not cancelled. Use numeric_result when the statement gives a number ("0 participants").

requirements.question: Registered primary endpoint {number}: "{text}". Quote the passage that gives this endpoint's result.
requirements.guidance: The document may name the endpoint differently (shorter, translated, as an objective, or by the measure it uses): match it by meaning. Prefer the passage with its numeric result. If only part of a combined endpoint is reported, quote what is there and say in note what is missing. If the document says why there is no result, quote that statement (not_analysed).
